description: Java class implementing a rule node for fetching and enriching message metadata with telemetry data from a time series database, used within the Thingsboard rule engine.

classes.name: TbGetTelemetryNode
classes.description: Implements a rule node for retrieving telemetry data and enriching message metadata within the Thingsboard rule engine.

classes.name: Interval
classes.description: Helper class representing a time interval with start and end timestamps.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, setting fetch mode, limits, and sorting order based on configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, retrieves telemetry data for the specified interval, and updates message metadata.

methods.name: buildQueries
methods.description: Constructs time series queries based on interval and keys.

methods.name: updateMetadata
methods.description: Updates message metadata with retrieved telemetry data.

methods.name: processSingle
methods.description: Processes a single telemetry entry into JSON node.

methods.name: processArray
methods.description: Processes telemetry entries into an array in JSON node.

methods.name: buildNode
methods.description: Builds a JSON node representing a telemetry entry.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Determines the time interval for telemetry retrieval based on configuration and message.

methods.name: getIntervalFromPatterns
methods.description: Extracts interval timestamps from message patterns.

methods.name: checkPattern
methods.description: Validates and parses pattern values from message.

methods.name: getValuePattern
methods.description: Extracts value from pattern using message data.

methods.name: replaceRegex
methods.description: Removes special characters from pattern string.

methods.name: validateLimit
methods.description: Validates the limit parameter within allowed range.

methods.name: getCurrentTimeMillis
methods.description: Returns current system time in milliseconds.
